description: Test suite for credits utility functions and related data normalization in a Node.js project. Includes tests for conversion between USD and credits, default environment variable handling, and verification of normalized credit fields in project/user objects.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Retrieves the current credits per USD rate from environment variables, defaulting to 20000 if unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on the current rate, handling numeric and string inputs, and returning 0 for invalid inputs.
